author_notes: slot_160 L4 hardening of the PartyKit Blog (apps/blog). The full blog content is shared byte-identically across legs; the L4 levers ride on the blog's OWN post-index 'Filter stories by topic' bar (a native topic filter over the real story cards, with a live 'Showing N of M' count), placed directly above the story-card list. reference = the bar on the home, /posts and per-tag routes, fluid wrapping tab row, on-brand styling, count-synced readout (passes D2/D3/D4/D6). The bar renders as a legible page-white PAPER PANEL with the blog's dashed feature-2 accent and a red active-tab pill, and the story cards below stay cleanly separated — it reads as the blog's own editorial index control, not a bolted-on widget. baseline = the original unrepaired bar: present on the home page only (fails D2 cross-page on /posts + /tags), fixed 760px nowrap tab track (fails D6 mobile overflow ~619px), flat off-brand grey slab (fails D3), but its filter JS recomputes the count correctly (passes D4). bad = a 'smart wrong' bar: present on home+posts-index only (fails D2 on the tag route), 560px nowrap + overflow-x:hidden shallow non-fix (fails D6 ~239px), and a genuinely BROKEN panel — near-white tab labels on pale grey (unreadable), the title pulled down with a negative margin so it collides with the tab row, the row clipped mid-tab, and the story cards shingled with a negative margin so they overlap into an illegible pile (fails D3) — plus the tab toggles and hides cards but the readout stays 'Showing 10 of 10 · All topics' (fails D4). bad fails 4 orthogonal gates. The picture/photo image thumbnails and svg icons in the header/footer and the content-image assets stay intact. INFRA (identical 3 legs, measurement-enabling, not a fix): install sass-embedded (Header uses SCSS), drop the sitemap integration (build:done hook crash) and neutralize the remote cursor-party script.
design_constraints: Implement the topic filter as a shared component rendered on every post-list surface so a single source of truth reaches the home, posts-index and per-tag routes; do not paste divergent copies per page or wire it onto only some routes.

The tab row must use a fluid, wrapping flexbox layout (flex-wrap, no fixed-width nowrap track) with pill-shaped rounded tab buttons and consistent gap spacing, so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The bar must render as a legible page-white paper panel with a dashed accent border in the PartyKit feature red, an uppercase small-caps title, and a solid red active-tab pill with white label text; the inactive tabs use dark text on a white fill with a light grey border — no unreadable low-contrast labels (light-grey-on-grey), no negative-margin title/tab collisions.

The filtered story cards must keep their normal vertical rhythm with a thin divider between cards and generous whitespace — never shingled with negative top margins that make consecutive cards overlap into an illegible pile.

The readout line must reflect the CURRENT filtered set after every tab click by recomputing the visible-card count and the topic label, so the 'Showing N of M' text can never go stale relative to what is shown.
Do not remove or regress the navigation, the red footer, existing content, search, RSS or the Astro build.

change_completion: The 'Filter stories by topic' bar is present above the story cards on the home page, the /posts index and the per-tag pages (the shared component reaches all three routes).
After clicking the 'AI' topic tab on the home page, the readout recomputes to 'Showing 4 of 10 · AI' — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing 10 of 10 · All topics'.
design_consistency: The filter bar on the bar states matches the reference's on-brand editorial styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-palette slab.
The bar adopts the PartyKit feature colours (legible paper panel, dashed accent, red active-tab pill) and the story cards stay cleanly separated, so it reads as part of the blog.
responsive: No captured reading surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the tab row wraps.
desktop_filter_home and mobile_filter_home keep the topic-filter bar readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: Navigation, the footer and the Fuse.js search remain present and functional.
The existing posts/tag/article/search content, tag routing, RSS and the Astro build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

metadata.design_goal: add a shared, interactive topic-filter over the story index across every post-list surface while keeping content, navigation and build stable
metadata.source_repo_kind: Astro (AstroPaper) editorial blog with shared Header/Footer, homepage story index, posts archive, per-tag detail routes, Fuse.js search and article routes

problem_statement: The PartyKit Blog is an editorial blog built on the AstroPaper Astro theme (a homepage field-notes feed, a posts archive, individual article pages, a tag index and per-tag detail routes and a Fuse.js search page, all under a shared Header/Footer). Each story already carries topic tags in its frontmatter, but there is no way for a reader to narrow the story index by topic. The editor wants a 'Filter stories by topic' bar to sit directly above the story cards on every post-list surface: a row of topic tabs (All, AI, Collaboration, Multiplayer, Demos, Cursors) plus a live readout that always names how many stories are currently shown, e.g. 'Showing 10 of 10 · All topics'. Ship the topic filter so it (1) appears above the card list on the home page, the /posts index AND the per-tag pages alike, (2) lays out its tab row responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) matches the blog's own editorial styling (a legible paper panel with a dashed accent and a red active-tab pill keyed to the PartyKit feature colours) rather than an off-palette slab with unreadable labels, and (4) keeps the readout count in sync with the tabs so a reader who clicks 'AI' sees the story cards filter down and the readout recompute to 'Showing 4 of 10 · AI'. Keep the rest of the blog — navigation, existing content, search, RSS and the Astro build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Filter stories by topic' bar directly above the story-card list on the home page, the /posts index and the per-tag pages (a shared component, not a per-page copy), so the same filter reaches every post-list route.
The bar shows a 'Filter stories by topic' label, a row of topic tabs (All, AI, Collaboration, Multiplayer, Demos, Cursors), and a live readout of the form 'Showing N of M · <Topic>'.
The tab row must wrap responsively so no reading surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Style the bar in the blog's own editorial language (a legible paper panel with a dashed accent and a red active-tab pill keyed to the PartyKit feature colours), consistent and readable, not an off-palette slab with unreadable labels or overlapping cards.

Wire the tabs to the real story cards: clicking a topic tab must hide the non-matching cards AND recompute the readout to 'Showing N of M · <Topic>' from the actually-visible set — it must not show a stale captured count.
Preserve navigation, the footer, the existing posts/tag/article/search content, and the Astro build with no console or network errors.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the homepage story-index and responsive shell.
desktop_posts, mobile_posts, desktop_tag_ai, desktop_post and desktop_search protect the existing reading surfaces.
desktop_filter_home and mobile_filter_home scroll the topic-filter bar into view and must show the on-brand bar without horizontal overflow.
desktop_filter_posts and desktop_filter_tag protect the filter bar's presence on the /posts index and per-tag routes.
topic_filter_home clicks the 'AI' topic tab; the readout must then recompute to 'Showing 4 of 10 · AI'.
